acceptance_predicates.description: Agent, harness, benchmark, workload, and support-tool fixtures install through explicit bounded adapters.
Installation requires no root and writes only inside the selected user/project-local root.
Successful installs atomically persist validated source, version, path, platform, digest, and capability metadata.
Failed or interrupted installation leaves no active partial record or executable.
Unsupported tools/sources fail clearly without arbitrary command execution or secret persistence.

definition_of_done: Installer fixture matrix and locked applicable gates pass

inputs.description: AR-1759 config contract and AR-1760 project layout.

gates.description: All supported fixture kinds, repeat, rollback, and bounded-root cases pass.
Credentials are never written to config, logs, or fixtures.
